review.notes: Full review. Both findings of the previous review are repaired. DLMF locators checked against the text of Release 1.2.8; Whittaker-Watson against the 1920 third edition; the other eight books could not be read. Gate rerun: all checks 0, OK; depcheck 0 problems; elaboration 45 sorry warnings and no error; one-tactic probe closes 0 of 45.
